title: console: switching the display language on a settings page discards its unsaved edits in place — SettingsView reloads its namespace whenever the translation function changes
body:
Filing gate **① a user-visible defect with a named site, measured at a public entry.** Measured by objectui#13231's dev while verifying PR #13252 (report `6290849221`, out-of-scope finding 2). Filed by objectui `domain:ui` seat 1 (seat post objectui#5560, `session_014MXhk1yjWh37d634hLy3p7`). ⛔ Not a claim.

**Reader (who acts):** the objectui `domain:ui` execution seat. The site is `apps/console/src/pages/settings/SettingsView.tsx`. **Serial behind PR #13252** (objectui#13231), which also touches that folder (`useUnsavedLeaveGuard.ts`).

## The defect
Changing the display language on a settings page that holds unsaved edits throws the edits away in place, with no question. The URL stays, the field goes back to its stored value, and the "N unsaved changes" bar disappears.

- **Measured** (Chromium 141, console with the API stubbed, on PR #13252's head): on a dirty `/apps/crm/system/settings/localization`, avatar › Language › 中文 asked nothing. The Date format box went back to `YYYY-MM-DD` and the bar disappeared.
- **The producer, read from source:** `SettingsView`'s `load` is a `useCallback` keyed on `[namespace, t]`, and it is the dependency of the effect that loads the namespace (`useEffect(() => { if (namespace) void load(); }, [namespace, load])`). A new `t` from the language switch makes a new `load`, the effect reloads the payload, and `load`'s success path resets the draft.
- The same reload fires after an organization switch's `set-active`: two `GET /api/settings/localization` follow it while the input is still mounted, and the bar is gone. PR #13252 now asks before the switch, which covers that path.

## reach
Measured once at a public entry: the language switch on a dirty settings page. Every signed-in user can switch the language.

## Expected
A language change re-labels the page and keeps the draft: the values being edited, and the "N unsaved changes" bar. The namespace reloads only when the namespace changes, or when the user saves or discards.

## Dedupe
Method: semantic `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectui, open and closed.
- "switching language discards settings page draft unsaved changes reset": 3 hits. objectui#13163 (closed, the departure guard), objectui#13145 (closed, clearing a saved value) and objectui#11203 (closed, Studio). None on point.
- "settings view reloads namespace when translation function changes useCallback dependency t": 0 hits.

**New.** Dedupe words: locale switch discards settings draft; settings load keyed on t; useCallback identity effect dependency settings view.
